integrity: General proofs are mathematical arguments; finite checks are supplementary. Characteristic-two field-valued involutions and normalized scheme are distinguished from the full unit-group scheme. No independent validation performed.
limitations: Not a classification of conjugacy classes, full-unit-group nonreduced involution scheme, longer nilpotency lengths, or general quotient relations. Historical publication priority is not exhaustively certified.
science_scope: Finite multiquivers and their length-three truncated path algebras over characteristic-two fields; unit group order-two points, reduced normalized involution geometry, finite-field order distribution, and MaxDiCut dimension.
title: Directed-cut geometry of order-two units in length-three truncated quiver algebras
